summary: Maddy Mail Server is an all-in-one email solution written in Go that integrates SMTP, IMAP, and authentication mechanisms into a single daemon. It aims to replace traditional multi-component mail stacks like Postfix, Dovecot, and various filtering daemons with a unified binary. The software is licensed under the GPL-3.0 and provides a complete mail server implementation.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want to run a complete email infrastructure without configuring and maintaining several distinct server applications.
watchOut: Consolidating all mail services into a single daemon introduces a single point of failure and means you must rely on a less conventional stack compared to battle-tested traditional components.
deployNotes: Being a Go binary, it typically runs as a standalone service with persistent storage for mailboxes and configuration files, alongside proper DNS and TLS certificate management.
